name: Ecwid
does: Hosted e-commerce platform (online store/shopping cart) with a REST API covering store catalog, orders, customers, payments and shipping.
auth_detail: Every request needs a Bearer access token (query-param token passing disabled). Public apps obtain tokens via OAuth 2.0; private 'custom' apps skip OAuth and copy a static access token from the app dashboard; native iframe apps receive an encrypted payload with store ID + token.
gate_detail: Anyone creates an app free in the Ecwid dashboard and gets a token for their own store immediately. Distributing a 'public app' to other merchants requires Ecwid's app review.
breadth: Broad: products, orders, customers, categories, discounts/coupons, payment and shipping integration, checkout, webhooks, plus storefront JS APIs and site theming.
notes: api-docs.ecwid.com 302-redirects to docs.ecwid.com. Official docs confirmed token-based auth with OAuth 2.0 for public apps; community MCP wrapper documented by Truto.

name: Gumroad
does: Creator commerce platform for selling digital products, subscriptions and memberships, with a v2 REST API at api.gumroad.com.
auth_detail: REST-based OAuth API returning JSON: register an OAuth application and click 'Generate access token'; five scopes (view_profile, edit_products, view_sales, mark_sales_as_shipped, refund_sales). The license-verify endpoint requires no OAuth app.
gate_detail: Any Gumroad account can register an OAuth app or generate an access token from account settings; no approval step.
breadth: Moderate: products (variant categories, offer codes, custom fields), user, sales (ship/refund), subscribers, licenses, and resource_subscriptions webhooks (8 event types).
notes: Live gumroad.com/api is an Inertia.js page (HTTP 200 but JS shell); content confirmed via Wayback snapshot. Community MCP servers listed on mcpmarket.com and hexmos.com.

name: fanbasis
does: Creator-monetization/payments platform (checkouts, funnels, courses, payouts) - rebranded to Commas: 'FanBasis is now Commas!'
auth_detail: No public API authentication documented anywhere. Marketing advertises 'APIs and SDKs' for enterprise; third-party/Zapier integrations imply a private partner API.
gate_detail: No public credential path exists. Enterprise page says 'Embedded checkouts, multi-rail payouts, APIs and SDKs' - API access appears to be a contact-sales/partner arrangement.
breadth: None published: no endpoint reference, developer portal, or API docs found for fanbasis.com or commas.com.
notes: fanbasis.com 301-redirects to commas.com; rebrand confirmed on-page. Commas homepage (fetched, 200) advertises a beta MCP tool ('Run Commas from your AI assistant. Create checkout links, issue refunds and pull your numbers in plain English') and enterprise APIs, but /enterprises is marketing-only. No developer docs portal found.

name: SE Ranking
does: SEO/AEO platform (rank tracking, backlinks, keyword research, site audits, AI-search visibility) exposing a Data API and Project API returning JSON.
auth_detail: 'Log in to your SE Ranking account, navigate to the API tab under the Settings section, and retrieve your unique API key.' Structured JSON responses; default rate limit 10 req/s (raisable via support).
gate_detail: 'API access is included in every SE Ranking plan' (Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo), testable in a free trial; standalone pay-as-you-go from $50/250K credits; API Add-On from $149/mo.
breadth: Broad: Data API (Backlinks, Domain Analysis, Keyword Research, AI Search, Website Audit, Account) plus Project API (project management, competitors, backlink checker, AI Results Tracker, local marketing).
notes: Official API page (fetched) itself advertises an MCP server 'for querying data conversationally from Claude, Codex, Cursor'; SE Ranking blog describes a hosted remote MCP with 180+ tools.

name: MrScraper
does: Web-scraping platform (managed scrapers/workflows plus a Scraper API with Web Unblocker) exposing a documented programmatic API.
auth_detail: 'All API endpoints require authentication using an API token passed in the x-api-token header' (marketplace endpoints use Authorization: Bearer). Base URL api.app.mrscraper.com.
gate_detail: Sign in to the dashboard, go to API Tokens, click New Token, set a name and expiration, and copy the token. Usage governed by the account's Token Plan.
breadth: Moderate: Scraper API (Scrape Markdown, Get Screenshot, Scrape JSON, Listing Page, Scrape Sitemap, Web Unblocker) and Platform API (Authentication, Scraper, Result, Analytic resources); scrapers can be exposed as API endpoints.
notes: Official docs list an MCP server for AI agents alongside Python, Node.js and LangChain SDKs and a CLI.

name: Sherlock
does: Open-source (MIT) Python CLI OSINT tool that hunts social-media accounts by username across 400+ social networks.
auth_detail: No authentication at all - it is a locally installed command-line tool (pipx/pip/uv install, Docker image, distro packages), not a hosted service.
gate_detail: Free open-source software; install from GitHub/PyPI and run 'sherlock <username>'. No credentials, keys or accounts involved.
breadth: N/A - CLI tool with JSON/CSV/XLSX file output and proxy options; no API endpoints or SaaS surface.
notes: It is a tool, not an API: the repo README (fetched) documents CLI usage only (400+ sites, ~92.6k stars). Community MCP exposure exists only as third-party wrappers, e.g. an Apify actor runnable through Apify's MCP server at mcp.apify.com.

name: Waterfall.io
does: B2B contact/company data API that aggregates 30+ data vendors behind one endpoint for contact/phone/company enrichment, prospecting, search and email verification.
auth_detail: 'All requests require an API key in the x-api-key header' (base URL api.waterfall.io). API Key Management supports master keys with sub-keys; some endpoints (Prospector, enrichments) are async.
gate_detail: No self-serve signup or trial. Main site offers only 'Book a Call' and an access-request form ('Thanks, we'll review your request shortly') - keys are issued after team review.
breadth: Broad for B2B data: Search Contact/Company, Prospector, Contact/Phone/Company Enrichment, Company Reveal (IP), Email Verification, Job Change Detection, Account Reporting; agent skills + llms.txt provided.
blocker: credentials are gated behind sales contact / access review (no self-serve)
notes: Official docs fetched: full REST reference with x-api-key auth. Docs point coding agents to 'Agent Skills' (a Waterfall API Skills GitHub repo) rather than an MCP server; MCP search hits refer to the enrichment technique or other vendors.

name: Bright Data
does: Web-data platform: proxies, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper APIs and datasets for collecting public web data.
auth_detail: Scrapers/Datasets API uses 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>'; 'We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically' (shown once, configurable permissions/expiration). Note: proxy/zone endpoints (Web Unlocker/SERP) traditionally use Basic auth with customer-ID/zone credentials.
gate_detail: Sign up and a default API key is created automatically; more keys via Account settings. MCP free tier gives new accounts 5,000 free requests/month.
breadth: Very broad: proxy network APIs, Web Unlocker, SERP API, scraper/dataset APIs, plus SDKs and a CLI reusing the same API key.
notes: brightdata.com/mcp 301-redirects to docs.brightdata.com/ai/mcp-server/overview: vendor-built MCP server (powered by Web Unlocker), deployable managed-remote or self-hosted, source at github.com/brightdata/brightdata-mcp.
